question: What is the primary focus of the newly introduced Bhairav Battalions in the Indian Army?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surprise Strikes and Counter-Insurgency Operations.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Army is establishing 25 Bhairav Battalions, which will focus on surprise strikes, counter-insurgency operations, reconnaissance, and high-mobility missions, particularly along volatile borders with China and Pakistan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Bhairav Battalions are a new hybrid combat model, blending infantry and Special Forces capabilities for terrain-specific missions.**
 
• **These units will be deployed for high-speed operations, cross-border strikes, deep reconnaissance, and to relieve Special Forces of less critical tasks.**
 
• **Five Bhairav Battalions are already operational, with plans to raise 25 battalions in total, focusing on northern borders, insurgency zones, and rapid mobilization areas.**
 
• **Insights from Operation Sindoor highlighted the need for these agile, versatile units to bridge gaps between infantry and Special Forces for faster, more coordinated responses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhairav Battalions**__

 __
 
• These battalions are designed to operate in diverse combat scenarios, utilizing rapid mobility and cross-border strikes to counter insurgency and other asymmetrical threats.
 
• With a mix of infantry, artillery, and air defence personnel, they are adaptable to various terrains and conditions.
 
 
 
• **Key Transformations in the Indian Army**__
 __
 
• **Ashni Platoons:** Special units within infantry for drone operations, surveillance, and loitering munitions.
 
• **Rudra Brigades:** Combined arms units for autonomous battlefield dominance using cutting-edge technology.
 
• **Shaktibaan Regiments:** Focus on unmanned warfare with swarm drones and precision strike capabilities.
 
• **Divyastra Batteries:** Advanced artillery systems integrating drones for real-time target tracking and precision engagement.
 
 
 
• **Vision for Modernization**__
 
 
• The introduction of these units reflects the shift towards AI-assisted, network-centric warfare, offering flexibility and tech-enabled battlefield readiness.
